ucs.title: [LLM] APT37/ScarCruft RokRat C2 over pCloud / Yandex / Dropbox APIs from non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts RokRat (and Dolphin/Chinotto variant) command-and-control, which uniquely tunnels tasking and exfil through legitimate cloud-storage REST APIs — api.pcloud.com, cloud-api.yandex.net and *.dropboxapi.com — to blend with normal HTTPS. Fires when a process that is NOT a browser or the vendor's own sync client reaches these specific endpoints, a signature of ScarCruft's RokRat family rather than generic cloud abuse.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where (Web.url IN ("*api.pcloud.com*","*eapi.pcloud.com*","*cloud-api.yandex.net*","*content.dropboxapi.com*","*api.dropboxapi.com*")) NOT (Web.app IN ("chrome","msedge","firefox","iexplore","opera","brave","dropbox","yandexdisk","pcloud")) by Web.src Web.dest Web.url Web.app Web.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let cloudC2 = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (cloudC2)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","pcloud.exe")   // vendor sync clients + browsers are the legit users of these APIs
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let cloudC2 = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com"]);
ImDnsActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where DnsQuery has_any (cloudC2)
| where isnotempty(SrcHostname)
| project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, DnsQuery, DnsResponseName
| order by TimeGenerated desc

      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\dropbox.exe'

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.pcloud.com OR eapi.pcloud.com OR cloud-api.yandex.net OR content.dropboxapi.com OR api.dropboxapi.com) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\opera.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\dropbox.exe OR *\YandexDisk.exe OR *\pCloud.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37/ScarCruft weaponized HWP/LNK document spawning script interpreter (RokRat loader chain)
ucs.description: Hunts ScarCruft's initial-access-to-execution chain: a spearphished Hancom HWP document or oversized LNK opened from Explorer/Office that spawns powershell, mshta, regsvr32 or wscript to stage the RokRat/Chinotto payload. Tied to APT37 by anchoring on Hancom Office (Hwp/Hword/Hcell/Hshow) and Explorer LNK parents — Korean-targeting tradecraft other crews rarely exhibit.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Endpoint.Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","Hwp.exe","Hword.exe","Hcell.exe","Hshow.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")) (Endpoint.Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")) by Endpoint.Processes.dest Endpoint.Processes.user Endpoint.Processes.parent_process_name Endpoint.Processes.process_name Endpoint.Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Endpoint.Processes)`
| search process IN ("*-enc*","*EncodedCommand*","*FromBase64String*","*DownloadString*","*IEX*","*Invoke-Expression*","*hidden*","*javascript:*","*mshta*","*http*")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","hwp.exe","hword.exe","hcell.exe","hshow.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","hidden","-w h","javascript:","mshta","http")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("explorer.exe","Hwp.exe","Hword.exe","Hcell.exe","Hshow.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc","-EncodedCommand","FromBase64String","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","hidden","javascript:","mshta","http")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 HWP/LNK document spawning script interpreter
id: 5c7e9a11-2d34-4f6b-8a90-scarcruft-hwpchain
status: experimental
description: Hancom Office or Explorer/Office parent spawning a script interpreter with download/encoded/proxy-exec arguments, matching ScarCruft RokRat loader chains
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\Hwp.exe'
      - '\Hword.exe'
      - '\Hcell.exe'
      - '\Hshow.exe'
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - 'EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'hidden'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'mshta'
      - 'http'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Office macros or admin login scripts launching PowerShell
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Hwp.exe OR *\Hword.exe OR *\Hcell.exe OR *\Hshow.exe OR *\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\rundll32.exe) @CommandLine:(*-enc* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *hidden* OR *javascript:* OR *mshta* OR *http*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(explorer|Hwp|Hword|Hcell|Hshow|winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|cmd|wscript|cscript|regsvr32|rundll32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-enc|encodedcommand|frombase64string|downloadstring|iex|invoke-expression|hidden|javascript:|mshta|http)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| count > 0
